notes.title: Holiday update: NOW WITH CARDS!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Thank you for your support of Cow Milking Simulator!

We've added some new props, a timed holiday theme (with a proper achievement for those who play during the season), and you can now collect Steam Cards of Cow Milking Simulator with some amazing illustrations! Check it out!!!

notes.title: Cow Milking is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019578/02ca4f1aeba112ee784baec19c92503f8491b1ee.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Thanks for taking the time to read this and to check on Cow Milking Simulator. 
This is a party game aimed at showing how fun VR can be, and a perfect game to show VR for the first time to your friends. Also, it's super fun to play and pass, and see who can make the highest score.

We plan on continue giving support for the game for a long time, and there's a lot of new features, props and game modes on the horizon. Keep with us!

We would love to hear what you want added on the game in the future, and what else you think of it. We also love to see videos of people playing it, so, if you do a video, let us know! 

This is it for now, thank you very much from all the development team here at IMGNATION Studios!
